incidents.name: Kipseli PropAMMWrapper quote-unit mismatch
incidents.notes: PropAMMWrapper paid out the integer returned by a USDC-denominated (6-decimal) quoter as raw units of tokenOut without asserting tokenOut was the quote token, so a WETH -> cbBTC route worth about 92 USDC transferred ~0.926 cbBTC (8 decimals) instead.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is the verified PropAMMWrapper created 2026-04-14 by 0xaee25670e53e86e1e6247c77fdaaf422a3c55b8d (not the attacker), no Upgraded events - the exploited code was 7.5 days old. DefiLlama records $72,350 (Input Validation / Missing Input Validation, Base).
